stem.text: Which diagram shows the electronegativity of the elements Na, Mg, Al and Si plotted against their first ionisation energies?

A.alt: Scatter plot of electronegativity against first ionisation energy for Na, Mg, Al and Si, with the points rising from lower left to upper right.

B.alt: Scatter plot of electronegativity against first ionisation energy for Na, Mg, Al and Si; Mg is placed lower than Al but further right, and Si is highest.

C.alt: Scatter plot of electronegativity against first ionisation energy for Na, Mg, Al and Si, with the points falling from upper left to lower right.

D.alt: Scatter plot of electronegativity against first ionisation energy for Na, Mg, Al and Si; Na is at the top left, Mg is above Al, and Si is at the bottom right.
